families.title: Fixed inclusive bounds and five values
families.initial: No state. Each instance supplies the listed ordered bounds.
families.enumeration: Values in written order; each instance is called twice with identical arguments.
families.method: Compare both returns to the source rule independently; repeated calls also check absence of retained state.
families.expected_rule: For value < -3 expect -3; value > 4 expect 4; otherwise expect value. Both repeated calls must agree.

static_checks.title: Bounded C90 arithmetic and state scope
static_checks.method: Read the exact locked source and header. Inspect comparisons, returns and declarations without deriving dynamic expected values from implementation.
static_checks.criterion: No subtraction, overflow-producing arithmetic, loops, recursion, allocation, external calls or mutable static state.
static_checks.boundary: Only the locked C/H function. This review item is unexecuted; real RTOS timing and WCET are outside the document-generation task.
